error_model.logging: Does not log; relies on Cleanable checks.
raises: RuntimeError if used after cleanup via Cleanable.check_cleaned

side_effects: Allocates incident ids and registers incidents

runtime_couplings: Owns Incident instances and manages their lifecycle

dependents.notes: Used by DevOps managers and tools to track incidents.

integration_flow: Query incidents by id or filters
Clean up incident registry when shutting down

usage_snippets.code:
manager = IncidentManager()
incident = manager.create_incident(kind='validation_failed', severity=IncidentSeverity.error, summary='Validation failed')
open_incidents = manager.list_incidents(status=IncidentStatus.open)
usage_snippets.title: Create and list incidents

order_constraints: Cleanup incidents before clearing the registry

lifecycle.construction: Initializes an empty incident registry and id counter.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns Incident instances in its registry.

invariants: Registry operations are guarded by a lock
non_goals: Does not enforce incident policies or workflows

summary.detail: In-memory registry for DevOps incidents with creation and filter APIs.
summary.one_liner: Manages lifecycle and lookup of DevOps incidents.
